description: Réseaux de télécommunication générateurs de servitudes PT3, en Eure-et-Loir (28) : MAJ au 27/06/2019 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. The generator of a public easement is a geographical entity whose nature or function induced, by virtue of regulations, constraints on the way the land is occupied on the surrounding land. The disappearance or destruction on the site of the generator does not result in the removal of the easement(s) associated with it. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "PT3 easement generator telecommunications networks, in Eure-et-Loir (28): Update to 27/06/2019" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include télécommunications, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2019-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
